signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION DLANSP( NORM, UPLO, N, AP, WORK )

params.name: norm
params.reference: Specifies the value to be returned in DLANSP as described above.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is supplied.

-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part of A is supplied
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part of A is supplied

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$. When $N = 0$, DLANSP is set to zero.

params.name: AP
params.reference: The upper or lower triangle of the symmetric matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: where $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N$ when `NORM = 'I'` or '1' or 'O'; otherwise, `WORK` is not referenced.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
